about.head: 62e2953

name: v0.24.7
body:
## 🔒 Security

- GHSA-62qq-4q8q-5244: A short URL-shaped input could keep a Confluence Markdown write busy for an unbounded time. The fix is in #1898.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### Confluence

- **Markdown writes with a URL followed by many dots now finish quickly.** The bare-URL autolink pattern used by the Markdown converter backtracked over a run of dots after a short URL, so a few dozen characters could keep a write call and a CPU core busy indefinitely. mcp-atlassian now requires pymdown-extensions 12.0 or later and matches bare URLs in linear time (#1898).

## 📦 Dependencies

- pymdown-extensions 12.0 or later is required. The lock file and the Docker image move to pymdown-extensions 13.0 (12.3 on Python below 3.11.5) and Markdown 3.11.3, the versions a fresh install from PyPI already gets.
- With pymdown-extensions 13, bare URLs in Confluence Markdown follow GitHub's autolink rules: a URL right after `!`, `|`, `[` or `=` is no longer turned into a link, a short host such as `http://intranet` is linked, and a closing parenthesis that balances one in the URL stays part of the link. Use `[text](url)` for links that must always be links.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sooperset/mcp-atlassian/compare/v0.24.6...v0.24.7
